+## NATIVE-INDEPENDENT-SHAPE-20261021 — native shape companion candidate
+
+Owner: W1.1 / FRONTEND-IR-MEDIUM-1 / E2E-REAL-6.
+Sync: NATIVE-INDEPENDENT-SHAPE-20261021.
+
+Native semantic dimension relations now project independent M/N/K capacities
+through compact rank-two producer DAGs. A frame-v3 candidate retains typed
+capacity allocations, guarded active reinterpret views with actual compact
+strides, initialized storage and exact private-allocation retirement. Leaf
+lowerings emit typed MLIR launch-shape arithmetic at their physical ABI
+selection point. Whole-program export combines it with root bounds/equalities
+into a pure host shape function, lowered through LLVM during cold packaging.
+No Python shape evaluator or new numerical kernel template is introduced.
+
+The frozen fb089f08 compiler passes 621 focused integration/shape/legacy and
+registry cases. This includes all 34 independent-dimension full compiler-route
+cases, 27 controller checks and 56 compiled LLVM shape-function checks; four
+additional malformed member-IR cases pass separately. Direct and registered
+routes retain strict original-source replay. All 28 existing Target programs
+and twelve PTX member images remain byte-identical to merged control cc3e73c8.
+These are compiler and host shape-computation results, not new GPU execution
+or timing evidence. The retained frame-v3 provider, public preparation, owning
+RTX5070 numerics and separate timing domains remain follow-up required.
+All five original aggregate programs remain open; this slice has no PR yet.
+
+Not applicable to Apple physical admission: exact SM120 frame export changes no Metal/AIR calls or Apple runtime ABI. The CPU execution above proves shape arithmetic only; it is not Mac or Metal execution evidence. An Apple shape-frame consumer requires its own lifetime/ABI integration and owning-device proof.

index 69d8c2baf..3d8217af0 100644
--- a/docs/spec/NATIVE_TENSOR_PROGRAM_BOUNDED.md

 # Native bounded tensor program candidate
@@ -221,3 +221,66 @@ validation passes eight device cases plus 32 host transport cases (40 total).
 Ruff and zero-error mypy pass. Native compiler/runtime bytes are unchanged.
 The original timing packet retains its recorded pre-review Python identity;
 no new performance claim follows. See the packet's provider-review/ receipts.
+
+
+## Independent-dimension frame v3 candidate
+
+Sync: NATIVE-INDEPENDENT-SHAPE-20261021. This compiler/host-shape boundary
+is implemented; retained GPU frame-v3 execution and public integration are
+still in development. Existing v1/v2 ABI and numerical images are unchanged.
+
+A module may request named positive i64 M/N/K capacities through
+`tessera.native.tensor_program_shape_bounds_request`. Semantic SSA relations,
+not coincident trace extents, identify which tensor axes share each variable.
+Projection operates on a detached Graph. Fixed contraction axes remain fixed;
+unrequested roles cannot silently become dynamic through an aliased role.
+The current admitted envelope is compact rank-two straight-line semantic
+producers ending in an unfused, untransposed ordinary matmul. Wider layouts,
+control flow, arbitrary accumulator lineage and AD are separate obligations.
+
+Private allocations retain static capacities. An active
+`memref.reinterpret_cast` uses zero offset and strides `[active_columns, 1]`;
+using a capacity-pitched subview when columns change is invalid. Native
+verification checks positive capacity guards, shared-root axis equality,
+active volume, actual view sizes/strides, initialization, writer uniqueness,
+retirement after every reader, and preservation of the returned allocation.
+
+Each selected native leaf ABI emits a typed member shape function. Its i64
+arguments are the dimensions of each input and output buffer in pointer-ABI
+order. Its results are the kernel scalars followed by the three grid axes.
+The exporter accepts only a single block of checked integer constants,
+multiplication, addition and unsigned division by positive constants. Memory
+access, extra functions, incompatible arity and zero division are refused.
+The selected function is bound identically on the kernel and invocation.
+
+The whole-program `shape_program` has these transport fields:
+
+- `entry`: `__tessera_tensor_shape_plan`;
+- `ir`: the actual typed host MLIR computation;
+- `sha256`: the exact UTF-8 IR content digest;
+- `root_words`: twice the number of original rank-two inputs;
+- `plan_words`: twice the buffer count plus eleven words per stage.
+
+The host entry has native ABI
+`int32_t(const int64_t *root_dimensions, int64_t *plan)` after LLVM lowering.
+Input words are each original input's rows and columns, in source argument
+order. Output words first contain rows/columns for every buffer in frame ID
+order. Each stage then contributes eight scalar slots (unused slots zero)
+and its three grid extents. Block dimensions remain selected constants.
+
+All root bounds and semantic equalities and every selected launch capacity
+are checked before any output word is stored. Status zero means success;
+nonzero leaves every output word unchanged. Shape arithmetic is compiled
+through matching, content-pinned `mlir-opt`, `mlir-translate` and `clang` during
+cold packaging. Python transports these native bytes and does not evaluate
+shape expressions. The next runtime boundary must validate the capacity
+plan and execute this companion transactionally before effects, returning
+native output descriptors for allocation and checking borrowed storage,
+context and producer streams before committing retained-frame state.
+
+Compiler proof currently comprises 621 integration/legacy/registry cases
+and four additional unsafe member-IR controls. The 56 LLVM execution cases
+compare independent shape/scalar/grid oracles, changed dimensions, equal
+trace extents, fixed contractions, invalid inputs, untouched failure outputs
+and canaries. They prove host shape computation, not GPU tensor numerics or
+performance. No broad W1.1 or five-program closure follows from this boundary.

from pathlib import Path

import tempfile

def _sha(value: bytes) -> str:

    image_sha256: str

    plan_words: int

            or set(program) != {"entry", "root_words", "plan_words", "ir", "sha256"}
            or program["entry"] != "__tessera_tensor_shape_plan"

            or not 2 <= program["root_words"] <= 256

def _compile(ir, entry, root_words, plan_words, tools):

                                root_words, plan_words,
                                tuple((name, digest) for name, _, digest in tools))


def build_shape_companion(program, *, llvm_bin=None):
    """Compile typed shape MLIR with a content-pinned matching LLVM toolchain."""
    _validate_program(program)
    tools = []
    for name in ("mlir-opt", "mlir-translate", "clang"):
        tool = Path(llvm_bin) / name if llvm_bin is not None else find_llvm_tool(name)

    companion = _compile(program["ir"], program["entry"], program["root_words"],
                         program["plan_words"], tuple(tools))

    return companion
